full_suite.environment: Python 3.12 in Docker; source mounted read-only; isolated temporary caches; AI keys not passed

coverage: Real I1/I2 generation, durable candidate capture, cumulative counters and exhausted task
Native run_phase_dev restores the old candidate, charges exactly one new invocation and revalidates completed owners before accepting the repaired task
Original source bytes, failed attempts, invocation history and deadline are retained
Quality commands, required flags and coverage cannot change; timeout increases are limited to observed timed-out checks and the existing invocation timeout
Other profile limits and obligations cannot change; ordinary scope authorization cannot borrow timeout recovery
Missing exact authorization fields and changed prepared quality are refused
Selector crash and replay do not duplicate activation or reset counters
Existing feedback authority, requests and role responses remain unchanged; receipt reconciliation fences dispatch and counts manual scope once
CLI preview is read-only and grants no execution authority

limitations: The default attempt ceiling increases by one for every uncompleted task, including pending tasks; this requires explicit review
Task-specific check timeouts cannot change through this capability
No production targets, extra money, clocks, role allowances or automatic delegation capacity are granted
These are offline simulated-provider tests, not acceptance evidence or activation of issue 22
Candidate fixture and functional defects still require development and fresh native verification
